title: Jester Pose Sequence
description: Three separate illustrations of a stylized purple and white jester-like character shown in standing combat pose, mid-air falling pose, and lying defeated on the ground.
prompt: A stylized purple and white jester character with skull motifs, skeletal face paint, and swirling patterns on his outfit. He wears a jester hat with bells, bandages on his legs, and purple ribbons. Shown in three distinct views: dynamic standing combat stance on the left, mid-air falling pose in the center, and lying defeated on the ground on the right, all against a plain gray background, digital character concept art
